**The Move: Rf8+**

- After **Rf8+**, Black's only legal move is **Rxf8** (the e8 rook must block—the king has no escape squares: Kg7 is still check, Kh7/Kh8 move into the attack)
- Then **Qxf8#** is checkmate (the queen on f8 controls all escape squares; the king on g8 is trapped)

**Coaching Note:**
When you control the 7th rank with your rook near the enemy king, look for back-rank mating patterns. Black's king on g8 is confined with no escape squares. Rf8+ forces the rook to capture, but then Qxf8 is mate. Always calculate forcing moves first—checks and captures—especially near the enemy king.
